users.sql: SELECT RTRIM(USR_CODIGO) login,RTRIM(USR_NOME) name FROM dbo.SYS_USR WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND (LOWER(USR_CODIGO) LIKE 'tatian%' OR LOWER(USR_CODIGO) LIKE 'andres%')

production_destinations.sql: SELECT RTRIM(d.D3_LOCAL) destination,RTRIM(d.D3_USUARIO) login,COUNT_BIG(*) records,COUNT(DISTINCT d.D3_OP) ops FROM dbo.SD3010 d WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D3_FILIAL='04' AND d.D3_EMISSAO>=? AND d.D3_CF='PR0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SC2010 c WHERE c.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND c.C2_FILIAL=d.D3_FILIAL AND c.C2_LOCAL='05' AND c.C2_NUM+c.C2_ITEM+c.C2_SEQUEN=d.D3_OP) GROUP BY d.D3_LOCAL,d.D3_USUARIO ORDER BY d.D3_LOCAL,d.D3_USUARIO

op_state.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN C2_DATRF='' THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END state,COUNT_BIG(*) records,MIN(C2_EMISSAO) firstDate,MAX(C2_EMISSAO) lastDate FROM dbo.SC2010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND C2_FILIAL='04' AND C2_LOCAL='05' GROUP BY CASE WHEN C2_DATRF='' THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END

internal_movements_05.sql: SELECT RTRIM(D3_CF) cf,RTRIM(D3_TM) tm,COUNT_BIG(*) records FROM dbo.SD3010 WHERE D_E_L_E_T_='' AND D3_FILIAL='04' AND D3_LOCAL='05' AND D3_EMISSAO>=? GROUP BY D3_CF,D3_TM ORDER BY D3_CF,D3_TM

support_expedition_transfers.sql: SELECT RTRIM(d.D3_LOCAL) destination,COUNT_BIG(*) records FROM dbo.SD3010 d WHERE d.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND d.D3_FILIAL='04' AND d.D3_CF='DE4' AND d.D3_LOCAL IN ('06','07','10') AND d.D3_EMISSAO>=? AND d.D3_NUMSEQ<>'' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SD3010 p WHERE p.D_E_L_E_T_='' AND p.D3_FILIAL=d.D3_FILIAL AND p.D3_EMISSAO=d.D3_EMISSAO AND p.D3_DOC=d.D3_DOC AND p.D3_NUMSEQ=d.D3_NUMSEQ AND p.D3_ESTORNO=d.D3_ESTORNO AND p.D3_LOCAL='05' AND p.D3_CF='RE4') GROUP BY d.D3_LOCAL
